subject: Vertical ABM pilot kickoff (regulated workloads) — asset requests + approvals + deadlines
body:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Wallace <ethan.wallace@redwoodinference.com>, Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, May 1, 2025 at 9:12 AM
Subject: Vertical ABM pilot kickoff (regulated workloads) — asset requests + approvals + deadlines

Team — confirming kickoff + getting the asset train moving.

Pilot goal (6–8 weeks): validate repeatable positioning + outbound motion for regulated workloads (starting with finserv + healthcare), and generate qualified pipeline for Dedicated + Private.

Working folder (please use this as the source of truth):
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1uP3pJmK6nT-regulated-abm-pilot-working

Kickoff (today): 11:00–11:45am PT (calendar invite already sent)
Standing cadence: Tues 10:00am PT (30 min) for weekly ABM standup

Asset asks (with deadlines)
1) Messaging + approved claims (Owner: Soojin; approvers: Aisha/Naomi)
   - Deliverable: “approved language” + “do not say” list for outreach + landing page
   - Deadline: EOD Mon 5/5 (so Ben can build sequences + ads)

2) Regulated workloads landing page copy (Owner: Ethan; reviews: Soojin + Naomi + Elliot)
   - Draft in Drive: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1m8cLkQh0-landing-page-copy-draft-regulated/edit
   - Deadline: first full draft Tues 5/6; final for docs publish Fri 5/9

3) One-pagers (Owner: Ethan; reviews: Soojin + Naomi)
   - Finserv draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1q9rV2s6f-finserv-one-pager-private-deployments/edit
   - Healthcare draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1p4hY7k2b-healthcare-phi-one-pager-draft/edit
   - Deadline: v1 for internal enablement Thurs 5/8; customer-ready (no placeholders) Mon 5/12

4) Security FAQ + evidence pack index pointers (Owner: Naomi; exec sign-off: Aisha)
   - Deliverable: sales-ready FAQ + “how to share evidence pack” guidance, including what is gated / redacted
   - Deadline: Wed 5/7 (so Sales can answer questionnaires quickly)

5) Measurement + attribution (Owner: Tyler; with Ben)
   - Deliverable: UTM conventions + dashboard definitions (target coverage, meetings, SQLs, POC starts)
   - Deadline: Fri 5/2 for UTM/ops; Mon 5/5 for dashboard spec

6) Target accounts + persona map (Owner: Ben)
   - Target account sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1z2A0mV7k-target-account-list-finserv-health/edit
   - Persona/pain matrix: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1x0N3cJ9p-persona-pain-messaging-matrix/edit
   - Deadline: v1 list Fri 5/2; final list + assignment Mon 5/5

Approvals / guardrails (important)
- Anything that implies certification/attestation (“HIPAA compliant”, “FedRAMP”, etc.) must be cleared by Naomi + Aisha.
- Please keep copy grounded in what we can substantiate (SOC 2 process, encryption/KMS options, audit logs, SSO/SAML/RBAC, retention/residency controls).
- Elliot: final check for what’s going live publicly (docs/website).

Ben — please reply with how you want messaging packaged for sequences/ads (short bullets vs long-form). Soojin/Naomi/Aisha — please confirm you’re okay being “claim gatekeepers” for external-facing language.

Attached: kickoff agenda + current asset list/owners.

Camila
—
Camila Reyes
VP Marketing | Redwood Inference


---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Wallace <ethan.wallace@redwoodinference.com>, Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, May 1, 2025 at 9:27 AM
Subject: Re: Vertical ABM pilot kickoff (regulated workloads) — asset requests + approvals + deadlines

Works for me.

Re: packaging — for sequences + LinkedIn ads I need:
- 3–5 “approved claims” (one-liners) per persona (CISO/Sec, Platform/ML Eng, Procurement)
- 6–8 proof points we can cite safely (audit logs, SSO/SAML/RBAC, KMS/HSM integration option, VPC/on-prem patterns, retention controls)
- 3 objection responses (e.g., “why not just use hosted API X”, “we can self-host”, “compliance risk”) 

If Soojin can put those in a single page with persona headers, I can translate to copy fast.

Also +1 on the “do not say” list — we’ve had reviewers flag HIPAA wording before.

Ben


---

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Wallace <ethan.wallace@redwoodinference.com>, Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, May 1, 2025 at 10:03 AM
Subject: Re: Vertical ABM pilot kickoff (regulated workloads) — asset requests + approvals + deadlines

Confirming I’ll own messaging/positioning + the approved language list.

I’ll share a v0 by tomorrow (Fri 5/2) for Security review, then lock by Mon 5/5.

Proposed structure:
- Core narrative (regulated workloads: reliability + security posture + deployment flexibility)
- Persona-specific bullets (CISO/Sec, Platform/ML, Procurement)
- Approved claims vs “avoid / requires substantiation” list
- Suggested CTAs (security review call vs benchmark/pilot)

Naomi/Aisha — I’ll tag you in the doc with the claims that need exact wording.

Soojin

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Wallace <ethan.wallace@redwoodinference.com>, Tyler Benson <tyler.benson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, May 1, 2025 at 10:18 AM
Subject: Re: Vertical ABM pilot kickoff (regulated workloads) — asset requests + approvals + deadlines

Yes — happy to be a gatekeeper for external claims.

Two reminders so we don’t create rework:
1) Avoid “HIPAA compliant/ready” unless we’re explicitly framing it as: supports common controls used in HIPAA programs (encryption, access control, logging, retention) and customer determines compliance.
2) For SOC 2: we can say we have an active SOC 2 program / can share report under NDA (depending on the request path). Please don’t imply public availability.

For the FAQ/evidence pack: I’ll publish a sales-ready version + a short “how to request/share evidence” note. Targeting Wed 5/7 is fine.

Naomi

Date: Thu, May 1, 2025 at 10:31 AM
Subject: Re: Vertical ABM pilot kickoff (regulated workloads) — asset requests + approvals + deadlines

Confirmed. I’ll do quick-turn reviews on the final claim language.

Please route anything that mentions:
- certifications/attestations (SOC, ISO, HIPAA, etc.)
- data residency guarantees
- retention guarantees

through Naomi + me before it’s published or used in outbound.

Aisha
CISO | Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, May 1, 2025 at 1:41 PM
Subject: Re: Vertical ABM pilot kickoff (regulated workloads) — asset requests + approvals + deadlines

Got it.

For anything going live in docs/website, please add me as a reviewer at least 24 hours before publish so we can do a compliance + consistency pass (esp. Dedicated vs Private wording and what’s “available today” vs roadmap).

Also: please avoid promising specific questionnaire response SLAs in public copy. We can commit in 1:1 conversations, but not broadly.

Elliot
Enterprise Docs
Redwood Inference
